newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to expand financial support to small firms.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to expand financial support to small firms.

text.p: South Korea will expand its financial support to small and medium-sized companies by about 30 percent next year, the Small and Medium Business Administration said on Monday.
An official at the administration said the government would contribute 2.3 trillion won to funds run by private and semi-governmental industry organisations, up from this year's 1.8 trillion won.
The money will be used to sponsor various programmes to encourage new technology development and boost smaller firms' international competitiveness, he said.
The government-run Small and Medium Industry Promotion Corporation will also give two trillion won in support to banks so that small and medium-sized firms can receive soft loans, he said.
This year, the government had extended to banks 1.5 trillion won in such funds, the official said.
